surfaces.rationale: AP-01 primary/orchestrator tier (<=15 elements, <=1100 token target); the budget is a hard cap set 42 tokens above the measured max, so regrowth is caught; AP-01's element budget stays the hard rule and its token target stays advisory, so passing this cap is not AP-01 compliance.

AP-01 two-workflow tier (<=15 elements, <=950 token target); the budget is a hard cap set 53 tokens above the measured max, so regrowth is caught; AP-01's element budget stays the hard rule and its token target stays advisory, so passing this cap is not AP-01 compliance.
AP-01 standard tier token target (<=1000); these are retrieval-workspace prompt scripts, and the measured max is the deep-research script.

AP-01 invariant-fragment cost: the canonical conduct (AP-08) and doctrine (AP-14) blocks count once per prompt, so this surface tracks the byte-exact blocks only; the measured max is the doctrine block since 1.5.0, which carries the plan-review gate.
SK-03 shape budget (1,200 target, 1,500 cap; vendor bodies are advisory); the measured max is a vendor body, so the registry ceiling follows it while the advisory cap stays in SK-03.

AP-01 standard tier: a command is a short invocation stub that must not grow into a prompt, so its ceiling stays far below the 1000-token target; the measured max is the orchestrate dispatcher, which names the whole loop.

AP-01 standard tier: the foreground components assemble into one prompt, so each component is measured alone against a component-sized share of the 1000-token target; the governance module now carries the loop line and the plan-review rule (WL-15), which is one statement in one module rather than six copies.
AP-01 preset tiers by schema kind (main 1100, subagent 800); the presets carry the doctrine block verbatim, so the ceiling follows the fragment and moves with it.
